item.title: b12431
item.description: server: answer reasoning_effort levels the template rejects with 400 ( #32332 ) The reasoning effort probe already renders every candidate level, but it dropped the ones the template raises on, so a request with such a level (e.g. max on Qwen3.8) reached the template and came back as a 500 on /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses and /v1/messages. Keep the raising levels in reasoning_effort_rejected and reject them in oaicompat_chat_params_parse with an invalid_argument, which the server answers w（來源：llama.cpp Releases）

item.title: v1.111.0-dev.4
item.description: Important Signing has moved to keyless cosign. Since v1.111.0-dev.3, releases are signed with Sigstore keyless signing (GitHub OIDC) instead of the cosign.pub key. cosign verify --key ... does not work for this release. Use the command below. Earlier releases still verify with the key. Verify this release cosign verify \ --certificate-identity https://github.com/BerriAI/project-releaser/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/heads/main \ --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercont（來源：LiteLLM Releases）
